2:249.text: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes
in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a

few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient."

2:250.text: And when they went forth to
Goliath and his soldiers, they said, "Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people."

2:251.text: So they defeated them by permission of Allāh, and David killed Goliath, and Allāh gave him the kingship and wisdom
and taught him from that which He willed. And if it were not for Allāh checking
people by means of others, the earth would have been corrupted, but Allāh is the possessor of bounty for the worlds.

2:252.text: These are the verses of Allāh which We recite to you,
, in truth. And indeed, you are from among the messengers.
